Royal Bank Of Canada And 2 Other Top Canadian Dividend Stocks
summary: Rising U.S. inflation and talk of higher interest rates have put reliable income back in the spotlight for Canadian investors. Cash in a savings account feels safer, but it does not grow its payout in the same way a business can increase its dividend. That is where Canadian companies that steadily lift earnings and keep their dividend yield in the 2% to 5% range come in. This article highlights three such stocks from this growing payout group.
